mapper.select: SELECT people_id, biz_date FROM reward_point_ledger WHERE biz_type IN ('PLAN', 'MED', 'VITAL') AND biz_date >= #{from} AND is_deleted = 0 AND people_id IN #{p} GROUP BY people_id, biz_date HAVING SUM(points) > 0
mapper.sql: pk_id, id, tenant_id, people_id, level_max, streak_days, best_streak, freeze_cards, last_settled_date, last_push_date, reward_disabled, peer_opt_out, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reward_summary WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM reward_summary WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND people_id IN #{p}
mapper.update: UPDATE reward_summary SET level_max = #{levelMax}, streak_days = #{streakDays}, best_streak = #{bestStreak}, freeze_cards = #{freezeCards}, last_settled_date = #{lastSettledDate}, gmt_modified = #{gmtModified} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reward_summary SET reward_disabled = #{disabled}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE reward_summary SET last_push_date = #{day}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE reward_summary SET peer_opt_out = #{optOut}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.points), 0) FROM reward_point_ledger l INNER JOIN people_org_membership m ON m.people_id = l.people_id AND m.org_id = #{orgId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN reward_summary s ON s.people_id = l.people_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.reward_disabled = 0 WHERE l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.biz_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND l.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reward_day d INNER JOIN people_org_membership m ON m.people_id = d.people_id AND m.org_id = #{orgId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN reward_summary s ON s.people_id = d.people_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.reward_disabled = 0 WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.biz_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND d.full_day = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.people_id) FROM reward_day d INNER JOIN people_org_membership m ON m.people_id = d.people_id AND m.org_id = #{orgId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN reward_summary s ON s.people_id = d.people_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.reward_disabled = 0 WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.biz_date = #{day} AND d.active = 1 AND d.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward_day( id, tenant_id, people_id, biz_date, active, full_day, due_count, done_count, freeze_used, streak_after, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{peopleId}, #{bizDate}, #{active}, #{fullDay}, #{dueCount}, #{doneCount}, #{freezeUsed}, #{streakAfter}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = VALUES(active), full_day = VALUES(full_day), due_count = VALUES(due_count), done_count = VALUES(done_count), freeze_used = VALUES(freeze_used), streak_after = VALUES(streak_after), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, people_id, badge_code, badge_name, kind, earned_date, source_ref, gmt_created FROM reward_badge WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY earned_date DESC, pk_id DESC
SELECT id, tenant_id, org_id, people_id, staff_id, kudos_date, message, gmt_created FROM reward_kudos WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created DESC LIMIT #{limit}
